The filing wall is stated before you start: you'll need to "create a USPTO.gov account with multifactor authentication methods and verify your identity before you can log in to access TEAS and Trademark Center."
A keyless preview path is published: "You can preview TEAS forms without logging in" — the forms are inspectable before the account wall.

Patent Center documents direct API usage against its application-viewing surfaces: "For users making direct API calls to Workbench/view applications, this update required a change to the version level of the APIs within Workbench/view applications."
PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 404 at https://www.uspto.gov/llms.txt
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 404 at https://www.uspto.gov/trademarks/apply.md
PROBE openapi: all candidate paths 404 (https://www.uspto.gov/openapi.json, https://www.uspto.gov/swagger.json, https://www.uspto.gov/api/openapi.json, https://www.uspto.gov/.well-known/openapi.json)

PROBE api.uspto.gov keyless GET: HTTP 403, body starts "{\"message\":\"Missing Authentication Token\"}" (observed 2026-10-05, single GET, no retry) — a real machine endpoint that answers unauthenticated requests with a structured auth challenge: an API-key model, not a bot wall.

PROBE developer portal: HTTP 200 at https://developer.uspto.gov/ (observed 2026-10-05) — the developer portal serves a JavaScript app shell to a keyless agent (API docs render only after JS execution), so the machine documentation is not readable by a plain keyless fetch.
